free_text: Although the patient has a prior positive biopsy, the evidence strongly suggests further investigation due to the PSA velocity of 1.78 ng/mL/yr and the presence of a new PI-RADS 4 lesion on the mpMRI. Since the prior ISUP grade was not documented in the retrieved reports, sampling is necessary to characterize the lesion and determine the appropriate management pathway. The statistical prior suggested biopsy, and the retrieved evidence supports proceeding with further sampling.
